title: Completed derived change bridge for finite constant models
statement: For a scheme X, commutative rings B and C, a ring map q : B → C, and a cochain complex P of B-modules, the selected completed derived change along the constant coefficient map applied to the finite constant model of P is isomorphic to the derived constant-realization extension along the lifted ring map applied to the lifted constant realization of P. The constant functors preserve zero morphisms.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 0G7E; uniqueness of the derived change-of-rings pair

proof.text: Use the selected completed-change witness and the general sheaf derived coefficient adjunction to obtain an adjunction whose left functor is the selected completed derived change.

Use the derived constant-realization adjunction and uniqueness of left adjoints to obtain a natural isomorphism between the selected completed derived change and constant scalar realization extension.

Evaluate this isomorphism on the finite model, transporting from the derived constant functor object to the explicit Q of the finite constant complex with the canonical mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh isomorphism.

theorem finiteModel_constantScalarExtension_derivedChangeBridge
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {B C : Type t} [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (q : B →+* C)
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X C).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (adicConstantMap X q)).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B P)) ≅
        (ConstantScalarRealization.derivedExtension (ProEt.topology X)
          (RingHom.ulift.{t + 1, t + 1} q)).obj
          ((commutativeSiteDerivedConstantModuleFunctor (ProEt.topology X)
            (ULift.{t + 1} B)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                  (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
                    (.up ℤ)).obj P))))
